name: conditional_save_for_backward
description: Skip save_for_backward tensors when gradient is not needed — saves 10+ ms per layer
steps: Audit ctx.save_for_backward() calls in the custom autograd Function
Add conditional: only save tensors when ctx.needs_input_grad[i] is True
For inference-only paths, skip all saves entirely
Benchmark: expect 5-15 ms savings per layer from eliminated HBM writes
expected_impact: 5-15 ms per layer savings from eliminated unnecessary tensor saves
